annotations.title: Search queries for a site or page

description: For one of the organization's connected websites, the Google searches it appeared for over a window of days: clicks, impressions, click-through rate and average position per search, for the whole site or one page. Search Console leaves out rare searches, so totals are lower than in Search Console. At most 366 days. A website that is not this organization's, not verified or not connected to Google answers not found. It changes nothing.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the 28 days ending on the latest day with data.

limit.description: How many searches, most clicked first (default 100).

page.description: Only searches that showed this page, exactly as webops_pages returns it.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the 28 days ending on the latest day with data.

name: webops_searches
title: Search queries for a site or page
